card.name: Alternative-health text anticipating toxin words
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens (digits, commas, small linking words, "Dr") in alternative-medicine or environmental-harm passages, where a word like toxicity or toxins could come next.

modes.label: Numbers in alt-health stories
modes.description: The first digit of an age or year inside a story about alternative treatments or dental amalgam.
modes.example: whose <<1>>9-year-old autistic son has tried alternative

modes.label: Punctuation in symptom lists
modes.description: Commas and "and" inside lists of related conditions such as chronic fatigue and immune dysfunction.
modes.example: chronic fatigue<<,>> chronic fatigue and immune dysfunction syndrome

modes.label: Detox and critic quotes
modes.description: Words in detox or cellphone-harm claims, such as "remove" or the title "Dr" before a named critic.
modes.example: This, says<< Dr>>. Carlo, is the most likely mechanism

card.writes: It pushes toward words about toxicity, toxins, mercury and mold.
